Two basepoint blowups preserve the discriminant and give rank 18. The sixteen nonidentity components and fiber/section span a full-rank lattice of determinant 2^14 (five-leaf star block determinant 16), hence index 16. Since q=0, Shioda Theorem 2.1 gives exactly 16 Jacobian points. Six rational Weierstrass points generate full J[2] of order 16, and linear system |2O| proves no further rational curve points. All nonstandard premises were checked in their cited primary texts; exact arithmetic replay passes.

value.rationale: The very general six-line genus-two pencil is a natural geometric object of Bannai–Tokunaga (2026). Its complete K-rational point set and Jacobian MW group over C(t) are intrinsic arithmetic invariants, and the theorem excludes all non-Weierstrass rational sections. The exact group is not implied by singular-fiber types alone without a generic Picard computation, and it bounds subsequent questions about special Picard-jump configurations. It is an exact uniform family classification, not arbitrary finite enumeration.
